paragraphs.text: Local-first research plugin + skills for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
# dsh-research-kit
Local-first research toolkit for DeepSeek Harness (DSH / `dsh`).
One DSH host plugin and two DSH skills that turn external web research into a managed, compounding k
lugin and two DSH skills that turn external web research into a managed, compounding knowledge base:
| Piece | Kind | What it is |
| `dsh-research-kit` | DSH host plugin | Registers three model-facing tools — `kb_grep`, `kb_list`,
`kb_save` — that read and write a markdown knowledge base through the scoped `ctx.fs` filesystem ser

vice. Pure Node ESM, zero runtime dependencies, no network. |
| `local-first-research` | DSH skill |
The protocol: **query local caches first**, fall back to the web only when local is insufficient, a

nd **persist everything fetched back to local storage** so knowledge compounds across sessions. |
|
`session-memory` | DSH skill | The protocol: answer "what did I do before?" from **prior DSH session
s** (`session_search`, `session_event_search`, `session_event_trace`, `session_trace`) instead of re
-asking the model for context it already has. |
The idea: an agent that keeps a local knowledge base stops paying full web cost for facts it already
has, and every fetched page becomes a reusable, citable, versioned markdown resource instead of a o
ne-shot context blob.

## Plugin tools
| Tool | What it does | Notes |
| `kb_grep` | Search KB file contents with a regular expression (ripgrep syntax). Returns matching l
ines grouped by file. | Uses `rg` when available on the host, falls back to `grep -rn`. Scoped to th

e KB root. |
| `kb_list` | List KB files, newest-first. Optional `include` suffix filter and `limit`

. | Pure `ctx.fs.listDir` walk; no subprocess. |
| `kb_save` | Save one fetched page as a new or upd
ated `06-资源/<yyyy-mm-dd>_<slug>.md` resource file. Validates frontmatter fields. | Path construction
is owned by the tool; the model never assembles KB paths itself. |
## Why local-first?
Web search is slow, rate-limited, and non-deterministic. A local knowledge base:

- is a file system — `grep` is a tool every agent already has;
- is inspectable and diff-able (git-f
t honest — it must show *what* it found locally before it is allowed to spend web tokens.
The `local-first-research` skill encodes that discipline; `dsh-research-kit` makes the "save what yo
u found" step a one-tool-call instead of a shell chain.
